40009342.author: पदार्थः
40009342.content: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामस्य Rama's, हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम्  joy and manliness increased, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा heard, राघवम् to Rama, पूजयाञ्चक्रे offered prayers, प्रशशंस च and praised.

40009342.author: Translation
40009342.content: The words of Rama boosted Sugriva's joy and manliness. He offered him prayers and praise:

40009343.author: पदार्थः
40009343.content: प्रज्वलितैः by blazing, तीक्ष्णैः by the sharp, मर्मातिगैः  go through vital parts, शरैः with arrows, कुपितः outraged one, त्वम् you, युगान्ते at the end of the Yuga, भास्करः इव like the Sun, लोकान् worlds, दहेः you many burn, असंशयम् no doubt.

40009343.author: Translation
40009343.content: 'There is no doubt that your sharp, blazing arrows will pierce through the vital parts of the body once you are angry, just as the Sungod burns all worlds at the end of the Yuga.

40009344.author: पदार्थः
40009344.content: वालिनः Vali's, यत् such, पौरुषम् manliness, तत् that, यत् वीर्यम् such valour, तत् that, या धृतिश्च courage, मम my, एकमनाः concentrate, श्रुत्वा on hearing, यत् which, अनन्तरम् after that, विधत्स्व  do what is to be done.

40009344.author: Translation
40009344.content: Listen with single-minded attention as I tell of Vali's manliness, valour and fortitude, and then do what should be done thereafter.

40009345.author: पदार्थः
40009345.content: वाली Vali, व्यपगतक्लमः without getting tired, सूर्ये when the Sun, अनुदिते has not yet risen, पश्चिमात् from the west, समुद्रात् from the ocean, पूर्वम् east, दक्षिणात् from the south, उत्तरम् north, क्रामति crosses over.

40009345.author: Translation
40009345.content: 'In the early hours before Sunrise Vali crosses over the oceans from the west to the east and moving from south to north (performing sandhya) without getting fatigued.

40009346.author: पदार्थः
40009346.content: वीर्यवान् valiant , शैलानाम् of the mountains, आग्राणि tops, आरुह्य ascending, महान्ति huge, शिखराणि peaks, तरसा speedily, ऊर्ध्वम् upward, उत्क्षिप्य climbing, प्रतिगृह्णाति catches.

40009346.author: Translation
40009346.content: 'Climbing up speedily, valiant Vali would catch the huge mountain peaks.

40009347.author: पदार्थः
40009347.content: आत्मनः his, बलम् strength, प्रथयता exihibiting, वालिना by Vali, वनेषु in the forests, सारवन्तः sturdy, विविधाः several, बहवः many, द्रुमाः trees, तरसा with vigour, भग्नाः break

40009347.author: Translation
40009347.content: 'Vali would break several sturdy trees in the forest with his vigour and speed, exhibiting his strength.

40009348.author: पदार्थः
40009348.content: कैलासशिखरप्रभः shining like the peak of mount Kailas, वीर्यवान् valiant one, महिषः mighty buffalo, दुन्दुभिः नाम by name Dundubhi, नागसहस्रस्य of a thousand elephants, बलम् strength, धारयामास possessed.

40009348.author: Translation
40009348.content: 'Massive like the shining peak of mount Kailas and valiant like the mightybuffalo in form, Dundubhi possessed the strength of a thousand elephants.

40009349.author: पदार्थः
40009349.content: वीर्योत्सेकेन proud of valour, वरदानात् by virtue of boons, मोहितः deluded, दुष्टात्मा wickedself, महाकायः of huge body, सः he (Dundubhi), सरितां पतिम् lord of rivers, समुद्रम् to ocean, जगाम went.

40009349.author: Translation
40009349.content: 'Wicked Dundubhi of huge body was proud of his valour and deluded by virtue of the boons, went to the ocean, the lord of rivers.

40009350.author: पदार्थः
40009350.content: ऊर्मिमन्तम् with waves, रत्नसञ्चयम् a hoarder of gems, सागरम् ocean, अभिक्रम्य after reaching, मह्यं to me, युद्धम् war, प्रयच्छ give, इति thus, तम् him, महार्णवम् mighty ocean, उवाच said.

40009350.author: Translation
40009350.content: 'Reaching the mighty ocean, he implored the sea with (high) waves and hoards of gems for a fight.

40009351.author: पदार्थः
40009351.content: राजन् O king, ततः then, धर्मात्मा righteous self, महाबलः  powerful समुद्रः ocean, समुत्थाय  rising, कालचोदितम् driven to death by fate, असुरम् demon, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40009351.author: Translation
40009351.content: 'O king, then the powerful and righteous king of the ocean came out and spoke to the demon (Dundubhi) who was driven to death by fate.'

40009352.author: पदार्थः
40009352.content: युद्धविशारद O warrior proficient in war, ते to you, युद्धम् war, दातुम् to offer (challenge), समर्थः not capable, नास्मि I am not, यः he who, ते to you, युद्धम् war, प्रदास्यति will give, अभिधास्यामि I can name him, श्रूयताम् listen.

40009352.author: Translation
40009352.content: 'You are proficient in warfare. I am not competent enough to challenge you to a duel. But  I will name the one who can.

40009353.author: पदार्थः
40009353.content: परम् supreme, तपस्विशरणम् abode of ascetics, शङ्करश्वशुरः fatherinlaw of lord Siva, हिमवानिति Himavan, नाम्ना by name, विश्रुतः wellknown, महाप्रस्रवणोपेतः great waterfalls, बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः many caves and caverns, शैलराजः king of mountains, महारण्ये in the great forest, सः he, समर्थः is competent, तव to you, अतुलाम् incomparable, प्रीतिम् love, कर्तुम् to do, आहवे in the war.

40009353.author: Translation
40009353.content: 'Himavan, the supreme abode of ascetics is the fatherinlaw of Lord Siva. He is wellknown as king of mountains, who has, waterfalls, caves, caverns and great forests.He is competent to match your incomparable love for war.

40009354.author: पदार्थः
40009354.content: परम् supreme, तपस्विशरणम् abode of ascetics, शङ्करश्वशुरः fatherinlaw of lord Siva, हिमवानिति Himavan, नाम्ना by name, विश्रुतः wellknown, महाप्रस्रवणोपेतः great waterfalls, बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः many caves and caverns, शैलराजः king of mountains, महारण्ये in the great forest, सः he, समर्थः is competent, तव to you, अतुलाम् incomparable, प्रीतिम् love, कर्तुम् to do, आहवे in the war.

40009354.author: Translation
40009354.content: 'Himavan, the supreme abode of ascetics is the fatherinlaw of Lord Siva. He is wellknown as king of mountains, who has, waterfalls, caves, caverns and great forests.He is competent to match your incomparable love for war.

40009355.author: पदार्थः
40009355.content: असुरोत्तमः best of demons, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, तम् him, समुद्रम् ocean, भीतः frightened, इति thus, विज्ञाय  knowing, चापात् from the bow, च्युतः released, शर इव arrowlike, हिमवद्वनम् forest of Himavan, आगम्य  reached, ततः then, तस्य गिरेः of that mountain, श्वेताः white, गजेन्द्र (like) elephants, विप्रला huge, शिलाः rocks, बहुधा several, भूमौ on the earth, चिक्षेप threw, विननाद roared, च also.

40009355.author: Translation
40009355.content: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.

40009356.author: पदार्थः
40009356.content: असुरोत्तमः best of demons, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, तम् him, समुद्रम् ocean, भीतः frightened, इति thus, विज्ञाय  knowing, चापात् from the bow, च्युतः released, शर इव arrowlike, हिमवद्वनम् forest of Himavan, आगम्य  reached, ततः then, तस्य गिरेः of that mountain, श्वेताः white, गजेन्द्र (like) elephants, विप्रला huge, शिलाः rocks, बहुधा several, भूमौ on the earth, चिक्षेप threw, विननाद roared, च also.

40009356.author: Translation
40009356.content: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.

40009357.author: पदार्थः
40009357.content: ततः then, श्वेताम्बुदाकारः in a white cloudlike form, सौम्यः a gentle one, प्रीतिकराकृतिः one who has a pleasing appearance, हिमवान् Himavan, स्वे on his own,  शिखरे एव on the peak, स्थितः he stood, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40009357.author: Translation
40009357.content: 'Then the gentle Himavan of pleasing appearance stood in the form of a white cloud on the peak and spoke:

40009358.author: पदार्थः
40009358.content: धर्मवत्सल devoted to dharma, दुन्दुभे Dundubhi, त्वम् you, माम् me, क्लेष्टुम् to trouble, नार्हसि it is not proper, तपस्विशरणम्  the resort of ascetics, अहम् I am, रणकर्मसु to wage war, अकुशलः हि not adept

40009358.author: Translation
40009358.content: 'Dundubhi, it is not proper for you to trouble me, for I am devoted to righteousness. I am the resort of ascetics and not adept in warfare'.

40009359.author: पदार्थः
40009359.content: दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, धीमतः of the wise one, तस्य गिरिराजस्य of that king of mountains, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा after hearing, क्रोधात् angrily, संरक्तलोचनः with eyes turned red, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच said.

40009359.author: Translation
40009359.content: "At these words of Himavan, the wise king of mountains, Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger replied:

40009360.author: पदार्थः
40009360.content: त्वम् you, युद्धे in a duel, असमर्थः यदि if in capable, वा or else, मद्भयात् due to fear of me, निरुद्यमः unwilling, यः whosoever, युयुत्सतः wants to fight, मे with me, युद्धम् duel, प्रदद्यात् give me a challenge, समाचक्ष्व tell me.

40009360.author: Translation
40009360.content: 'If you are unable or unwilling to fight me out of fear, tell me who wants to challenge me to a duel.

40009361.author: पदार्थः
40009361.content: वाक्यविशारदः skilful in conversation, धर्मात्मा righteous, हिमवान् Himavan, श्रुत्वा on hearing, तम् him, असुरोत्तमम् best of demon, क्रोधात् in anger, अनुक्तपूर्वम् had not spoken earlier, वाक्यम् such words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40009361.author: Translation
40009361.content: 'On hearing such words, which no one had spoken earlier, righteous Himavan, skilful in conversation, flew into a rage and said to Dundubhi,the best of demons:

40009362.author: पदार्थः
40009362.content: महाप्राज्ञः wise one, शक्रपुत्रः son of Indra, प्रतापवान् powerful, श्रीमान् prosperous one,   वाली नाम Vali by name, वानरः monkey, अतुलप्रभाम् of incomparable glory, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkindha, अध्यास्ते residing.

40009362.author: Translation
40009362.content: 'Vali, son of Indra, is a wise, powerful and prosperous monkey. He resides at Kishkinda, a city of incomparable glory.

40009363.author: पदार्थः
40009363.content: महाप्राज्ञः wise, युद्धविशारदः expert in warfare, सः he, वासवः Indra, नमुचेरिव like Namuchi, तव to you, महत् great, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् duel, दातुम् to give (challenge), समर्थः competent.

40009363.author: Translation
40009363.content: 'Vali is profoundly wise, an expert in warfare. He is capable of challenging you to a duel like Indra to Namuchi.

40009364.author: पदार्थः
40009364.content: इह now, युद्धम् fight, इच्छसि यदि if you want to fight, त्वम् you, शीघ्रम् quickly, तम् him, अभिगच्छ  go now, शूरः heroic, सः he, नित्यम् ever, समरकर्मणि in warfare, दुर्धर्षणः हि difficult to combat.

40009364.author: Translation
40009364.content: 'If you wish to fight, go to him quickly.He is ever heroic and difficult to combat.

40009365.author: पदार्थः
40009365.content: तदा then, सः दुन्दुभिः that Dundubhi, हिमवतः Himavan's, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, कोपाविष्टः seized with anger, तस्य his वालिनः Vali's, पुरीम् city, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkinda, जगाम went.

40009365.author: Translation
40009365.content: 'Having heard Himavan, Dundubhi, seized with anger, went to Kishkindha,  the city of Vali.

40009366.author: पदार्थः
40009366.content: महाबलः mighty, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, माहिषम् buffalo, रूपम् form, धारयन् assuming, तीक्ष्णशृङ्गः  pointed horns, भयावहः frightening, प्रावृषि in rainy season, नभस्तले in the sky, तोयपूर्णः laden with water, महामेघ इव like a huge cloud, किष्किन्धायाः Kishkinda's, द्वारम् entrance, आगम्य reached, भूमिम् earth, कम्पयन् shaking, दुन्दुभिर्यथा like Dundubhi a wardrum, ननर्द roared.

40009366.author: Translation
40009366.content: 'Mighty Dundubhi assuming the form of a frightening buffalo with pointed horns looking like a huge, dark raincloud in the sky in monsoon marched to the entrance of Kishkinda and roared like a wardrum as if shaking the earth.

40009367.author: पदार्थः
40009367.content: महाबलः mighty, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, माहिषम् buffalo, रूपम् form, धारयन् assuming, तीक्ष्णशृङ्गः  pointed horns, भयावहः frightening, प्रावृषि in rainy season, नभस्तले in the sky, तोयपूर्णः laden with water, महामेघ इव like a huge cloud, किष्किन्धायाः Kishkinda's, द्वारम् entrance, आगम्य reached, भूमिम् earth, कम्पयन् shaking, दुन्दुभिर्यथा like Dundubhi a wardrum, ननर्द roared.

40009367.author: Translation
40009367.content: 'Mighty Dundubhi assuming the form of a frightening buffalo with pointed horns looking like a huge, dark raincloud in the sky in monsoon marched to the entrance of Kishkinda and roared like a wardrum as if shaking the earth.

40009368.author: पदार्थः
40009368.content: समीपस्थान् nearby, द्रुमान् trees, भञ्जन् felling, वसुधाम् earth, खुरैः with hoofs, दारयन् breaking, दर्पात् arrogantly, विषाणेन by the horn, तद्वारम् that entrance, द्विरदो यथा like an elephant, उल्लिखन् digging.

40009368.author: Translation
40009368.content: 'Dundubhi felled the trees nearby, rent the earth with its hoofs, scratched the entrance gate of the city as an elephant would do with its horns in arrogance.

40009369.author: पदार्थः
40009369.content: अन्तःपुरगतः in the harem, वाली Vali, शब्दम् sound, श्रुत्वा  hearing, अमर्षणः intolereable, ताराभिः stars also, चन्द्रमाः Moon, स्त्रीभिः with women, निष्पपात jumped out.

40009369.author: Translation
40009369.content: 'Unable to tolerate the sound, Vali jumped out of the harem along with the women like the Moon with stars.

40009370.author: पदार्थः
40009370.content: वनचारिणाम् forestrangers, सर्वेषाम् for all, हरीणाम् of monkeys, ईश्वरः king, (सः वाली that Vali), दुन्दुभिम् to Dundubhi, व्यक्ताक्षरपदम् a brief statement, मितम् in limited words, उवाच said.

40009370.author: Translation
40009370.content: 'Vali, king of the monkeys who roam the forest, saw Dundubhi and addressed, but briefly:

40009371.author: पदार्थः
40009371.content: दुन्दुभे O Dundubhi, इदम् this, नगरद्वारम् entrance of the city, रुध्द्वा  blocking, किमर्थम् for what reason, विनर्दसि are you roaring, मे to me, विदितः known, असि you are,महाबल O powerful one, प्राणान् life, रक्ष you may protect.

40009371.author: Translation
40009371.content: 'O Dundubhi why are you roaring, blocking the entrance of the city? I know you are powerful. Go and save your life.'

40009372.author: पदार्थः
40009372.content: धीमतः wise, तस्य his, वानरेन्द्रस्य of the king of monkeys, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा  hearing, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, रोषात् angrily, संरक्तलोचनः eyes turned red, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said

40009372.author: Translation
40009372.content: 'Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger when he heard the words of Vali ,the wise king of the monkeys, said:

40009373.author: पदार्थः
40009373.content: वीर hero, त्वम् you, स्त्रीसन्निधौ in the presence of women, वचनम् words, वक्तुम् to speak, नार्हसि not proper for you, अद्य to day, मम to me, युद्धम् war, प्रयच्छ you may give, ततः then, ते your, बलम् strength, ज्ञास्यामि I will let you know.

40009373.author: Translation
40009373.content: 'O hero speaking such words in the presence of women is not proper. Come to me for a combat and I will let you know your strength.

40009374.author: पदार्थः
40009374.content: वानर O monkey, अथवा or else, अद्य now, इमाम् this, निशाम् night, क्रोधम् anger, धारयिष्यामि I will control,  स्वैरम् freedom, कामभोगेषु for your sensual pleasures, उदयः morning, गृह्यताम् I will give you time.

40009374.author: Translation
40009374.content: 'O monkey I will restrain my anger tonight and give you time for your indulgence in sensual pleasures till morning.

40009375.author: पदार्थः
40009375.content: वानरान् of monkeys, परिष्वज्य embracing, सम्प्रदानम् a gift, दीयताम् may give, सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्रः king of all monkeys, त्वम् you, सुहृज्जनम् with dear friends, संसादय spend

40009375.author: Translation
40009375.content: 'O king of monkeys, hug them and give them any gift you want. Spend the night with your dear ones.

40009376.author: पदार्थः
40009376.content: किष्किन्धाम् Kishkindha, सुदृष्टाम् give a good look, पुरे the city, आत्मसमम् some one equal to you, कुरुष्व assign kingship, स्त्रीभिः with women, सह along with, क्रीडस्व च and sport, अहम्  am, ते to you, दर्पनाशनः a destroyer of arrogance.

40009376.author: Translation
40009376.content: 'Have a good look a Kishkinda. Assign some one like you kingship. Sport freely  with women and come, I shall destroy your arrogance.

40009377.author: पदार्थः
40009377.content: यः whoever, मत्तम् drunk, प्रमत्तं वा or heedless, सुप्तं वा or sleeping, रहितम् or without weapons, भृशम् greatly, मदमोहितम् stupified by lust, हन्यात् if killed, सः he, लोके in the world, भ्रूणहा हि is a killer of foetus in the womb.

40009377.author: Translation
40009377.content: 'Whoever kills a person, who is drunk or is heedless or is asleep or without weapons or stupified by lust in this world, is equal to a killer of a foetus in the womb.'

40009378.author: पदार्थः
40009378.content: तदा then, सः he, प्रहस्य laughing, ताराप्रभृतिकाः Tara and others, ताः those, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियः women, विसृज्य having sent away, मन्दम् slowly, तम् him, असुरोत्तमम् best of demons, क्रोधात् angrily, अब्रवीत् said.

40009378.author: Translation
40009378.content: 'Then, Vali sent away Tara and all other women slowly and replied angrily to the foolish demon with a mischievous smile:

40009379.author: पदार्थः
40009379.content: अयम् this, मत्तः a drunken person, इति thus, मा मंस्थाः do not think, संयुगे in the combat, अभीतः not afraid, असि यदि if you are, अयम् this, मदः drunkeness, अस्मिन्  सम्प्रहारे in striking you, वीरपानम् warrior's drink (sharpening a warrior's skill), समर्थ्यताम् consider.

40009379.author: Translation
40009379.content: 'Do not consider me drunken. This drink will serve as a warrior's drink in the combat. Be ready, if you are not afraid of a combat.'

40009380.author: पदार्थः
40009380.content: तम् him, एवम् that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सङ्कृद्धः angry, पित्रा by his father, महेन्द्रेण by Indra, दत्ताम् gifted, काञ्चनीम् golden, मालाम् garland, उत्क्षिप्य removed, युद्धाय for the combat, व्यवतिष्ठत stood ready

40009380.author: Translation
40009380.content: 'Having addressed thus in a rage, Vali removed the golden garland gifted by Indra, his father, and stood ready for the combat.

40009381.author: पदार्थः
40009381.content: तदा then, कपिकुञ्जरः elephantlike monkey, वाली Vali, गिरिसन्निभम् resembling a mountain, तम् him, दुन्दुभिम् Dundubhi, विषाणयोः by horns, गृहीत्वा  held, विनदन् roaring loudly, आविध्यत struck down.

40009381.author: Translation
40009381.content: 'Vali, the elephantlike monkey then held the mountainlike Dundubhi by the horns and struck him down, roaring loudly.

40009382.author: पदार्थः
40009382.content: वाली Vali, व्यापादयाञ्चक्रे whirled round, महास्वनम् great sound, ननर्द च roared, अथ then, पात्यतः  down, तस्य his, श्रोत्राभ्याम् from the ears, रक्तम् blood, सुस्राव flowed.

40009382.author: Translation
40009382.content: 'Vali whirled him round and round and threw him downroaring. Blood flowed from Dundubhi's ears.

40009383.author: पदार्थः
40009383.content: क्रोधसंरम्भात् highly agitated in anger, परस्परजयैषिणोः of both trying to win over the other, तयोः of both, दुन्दुभेः for Dundubhi, वानरस्य च and of the monkey, घोरम् terrific, युद्धम् combat, समभवत् took place.

40009383.author: Translation
40009383.content: 'Each one of them was highly agitated and angry trying to win over the other. A terrific fight took place between Dundubhi and Vali.

40009384.author: पदार्थः
40009384.content: तदा then, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः equal to Indra in prowess, वाली Vali, मुष्टिभिः with fists, जानुभिः with knees, च एव also, शिलाभिः with rocks, तथा so also, पादपैः with trees, अयुध्यत fought.

40009384.author: Translation
40009384.content: 'Then Vali who was equal to Indra in prowess fought, hitting him with fists, knees, rocks and trees.

40009385.author: पदार्थः
40009385.content: तदा then, तत्र there, वानरासुरयोः of monkey and demon, परस्परम् one to one, घ्नतोः pouncing on the other, युद्धे in fight, असुरः demon, हीनः reduced, आसीद become, शक्रसूनुः son of Indra, व्यवर्धत grew (in strength and spirit).

40009385.author: Translation
40009385.content: 'Then as the monkey and demon fought pouncing on each other, the prowess of Dundubhi got diminished and that of Vali, the son of Indra, increased.

40009386.author: पदार्थः
40009386.content: व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यै in effort, strength and courage, पराक्रमैः in prowess as well, परिक्षीणं deterioration, तम् Vali, दुन्दुभिम् Dundubhi, उद्यम्य having lifted, धरण्याम् on the ground, अभ्यपातयत् hit down, तदा then, प्राणहरे in the deadly, तस्मिन् in that, युद्धे fight, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, निष्पिष्ट: crushed, पातयतः thrown down, तस्य his, महाकायः of huge body, पञ्चत्वम् resolved into the five elements (dead), आगतः go, क्षितौ on the ground, पपात fell down.

40009386.author: Translation
40009386.content: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.

40009387.author: पदार्थः
40009387.content: व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यै in effort, strength and courage, पराक्रमैः in prowess as well, परिक्षीणं deterioration, तम् Vali, दुन्दुभिम् Dundubhi, उद्यम्य having lifted, धरण्याम् on the ground, अभ्यपातयत् hit down, तदा then, प्राणहरे in the deadly, तस्मिन् in that, युद्धे fight, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, निष्पिष्ट: crushed, पातयतः thrown down, तस्य his, महाकायः of huge body, पञ्चत्वम् resolved into the five elements (dead), आगतः go, क्षितौ on the ground, पपात fell down.

40009387.author: Translation
40009387.content: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.

40009388.author: पदार्थः
40009388.content: बलवान् powerful, वाली Vali, गतसत्त्वम् life drained, अचेतनम् lost consciousness, तम् him, बाहुभ्याम् with both shoulders, तोलयित्वा after lifting, एकेन in one piece, वेगेन with speed, योजनम् distance of a yojana (eight miles), चिक्षेप hurled.

40009388.author: Translation
40009388.content: 'Mighty Vali lifted on both shoulders the insensate body drained of life and hurled it speedily to a distance of a yojana.

40009389.author: पदार्थः
40009389.content: वेगप्रविद्धस्य flung, तस्य his, वक्त्रात् from the mouth, क्षतजबिन्दवः drops of blood, मारुतोत्क्षिप्ताः scattered by the wind, मतङ्गस्य Matanga's, आश्रमं प्रति at the hermitage of, प्रपेतुः fell.

40009389.author: Translation
40009389.content: 'Scattered by the wind, drops of blood fell at the hermitage of Matanga from the mouth of the deadbody flung.

40009390.author: पदार्थः
40009390.content: महाभागः venerable one, मुनिः sage, तत्र there, पतितान् fallen, शोणितविप्रुषः drops of blood, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, तस्य his, क्रुद्धः became angry, अयम् this, को नु who can  he be, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40009390.author: Translation
40009390.content: 'The venerable sage became furious to see drops of blood fallen there. He started thinking who could he be?

40009391.author: पदार्थः
40009391.content: दुरात्मना wicked self, येन by whom, अहम् I, सहसा instantly, शोणितेन with blood, स्पृष्टः touched, दुरात्मा a villain, दुर्भुद्धि: evilminded, अयम् he, बालिशः a petty man, कः who?

40009391.author: Translation
40009391.content: 'Who is that petty, wicked, evil minded one who caused the drops of blood to touch (fall on) me suddenly?

40009392.author: पदार्थः
40009392.content: सः he, मुनिसत्तमः venerable sage, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, विनिष्क्रम्य having come out, गतासुम् a dead one, भुवि on the floor, पतितम् fallen, पर्वताकारम् with a mountaneous form, महिषम् buffalo, ददृशे saw.

40009392.author: Translation
40009392.content: 'The venerable sage came out of the hermitage and saw a mountaneous buffalo fallen dead on the floor.

40009393.author: पदार्थः
40009393.content: सः he, तत् that, वानरेण by the monkey, कृतम् done, तपसा by ascetic vision, विज्ञाय having known, क्षेप्तारम् who hurled, वालिनं प्रति at that Vali, महाशापम् great curse, उत्ससर्ज pronounced.

40009393.author: Translation
40009393.content: 'Having known through his ascetic vision that it was the act of a monkey, he pronounced a curse on Vali who had hurled (the body):

40009394.author: पदार्थः
40009394.content: मत्संश्रयम् under my protection, वनम् forest, येन by whom, रुधिरस्रवैः with drops of blood, दूषितम् is violated, तेन by him, इह here, न प्रवेष्टव्यम्  should not enter, प्रविष्टस्य of him who enters, वधः death, भवेत् will take place.

40009394.author: Translation
40009394.content: 'Whoever has desecrated this forest, protected by me, with drops of blood is forbidden to enter this place. Once he does it, he will die.

40009395.author: पदार्थः
40009395.content: आसुरीम् demon's, तनुम् body, क्षिपता  hurled, इमे those, पादपाश्च trees also, सम्भग्नाः are broken, समन्तात् all over, पूर्णम् entire, योजनम् yojana, मामकम् mine, आश्रमम् hermitage, आगमिष्यति if he comes, दुर्बुद्धिः wicked  one, सः he, न भविष्यति will not survive.

40009395.author: Translation
40009395.content: 'Whoever has broken the trees all over this forest and has thrown the demon's body will not survive if he enters within a radius of one yojana  of my hermitage.

40009396.author: पदार्थः
40009396.content: मामकम् my, वनम् forest, संश्रिताः taking refuge, ये (केचित्) indeed, अस्य सचिवाः his counsellors, तैः च by them also, इह here, न वस्तव्यम् should not stay, श्रुत्वा on hearing, यथासुखम् safely, यान्तु depart.

40009396.author: Translation
40009396.content: 'Indeed his counsellors who are here must leave this forest. Let them depart safely.

40009397.author: पदार्थः
40009397.content: नित्यम् always, पुत्रवत् like a son, परिरक्षिते protected, मामके my, अस्मिन् वने in this forest, तेऽपि they also, पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय for destroying shoots, फलमूलाभवाय च and for the loss of fruits and roots etc, तिष्ठन्ति यदि if they stay back, तानपि them also, ध्रुवम् certainly, शपिष्ये I will curse.

40009397.author: Translation
40009397.content: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

40009398.author: पदार्थः
40009398.content: नित्यम् always, पुत्रवत् like a son, परिरक्षिते protected, मामके my, अस्मिन् वने in this forest, तेऽपि they also, पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय for destroying shoots, फलमूलाभवाय च and for the loss of fruits and roots etc, तिष्ठन्ति यदि if they stay back, तानपि them also, ध्रुवम् certainly, शपिष्ये I will curse.

40009398.author: Translation
40009398.content: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

40009399.author: पदार्थः
40009399.content: अस्य for him, दिवसः one day, मर्यादा time limit, श्वः tomorrow, यम् whosoever, वानरम् monkey, द्रष्टास्मि I will see, सः he, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, शैलः mountain, भविष्यति will become.

40009399.author: Translation
40009399.content: 'I give one day's time for the monkeys (to leave). Whomsoever, I see tomorrow will get transformed into a mountain for many thousands of years'

40009400.author: पदार्थः
40009400.content: ततः then, ते those, वानराः monkeys, मुनिसमीरिताम् spoken by the sage, गिरम् word, श्रुत्वा after hearing, तस्मात् वनात् from that forest, निश्चक्रमुः went away, तान् the, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, वालिः Vali, अब्रवीत् said.

40009400.author: Translation
40009400.content: 'The monkeys fled on hearing the words spoken by the sage. Said Vali:

40009401.author: पदार्थः
40009401.content: मतङ्गवनवासिनः residents of the groves of Matanga, भवन्तः you, समस्ताः all, किम् why, मत्समीपम् to me, अनुप्राप्ताः came here, वनौकसाम् for all the monkeys, अपि स्वस्ति hope all are safe.

40009401.author: Translation
40009401.content: 'Why have you, residents of the groves of Matanga, come to me? Hope all are safe'

40009402.author: पदार्थः
40009402.content: ततः then, सर्वे all, ते वानराः those monkeys, सर्वम् everything, कारणम् reason, तदा then, वालिनः of Vali, शापं च curse also, हेममालिने to him wearing golden necklace, वालिने to Vali, शशंसुः narrated.

40009402.author: Translation
40009402.content: 'Then all the monkeys collected together and narrated everything about the curse given to Vali , adorned with a golden chain(on his neck).

40009403.author: पदार्थः
40009403.content: तदा then, सः वाली that Vali, वानरेरितम् spoken by monkeys, एतत् all that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, महर्षिम् to the sage, (सम्) आसाद्य having approached, याचते स्म begged.

40009403.author: Translation
40009403.content: 'On hearing the monkeys, Vali went to the sage and begged forgiveness with folded hands.

40009404.author: पदार्थः
40009404.content: महर्षिः great sage, तम् him, अनादृत्य without obliging, आश्रमं to the hermitage, तदा then, प्रविवेश entered, वाली Vali, शापधारणभीतः with the fear of hearing the curse, विह्वलताम् agrieved, गतः became.

40009404.author: Translation
40009404.content: 'The sage went into the hermitage without obliging Vali who became apprehensive of the curse of the sage.

40009405.author: पदार्थः
40009405.content: नरेश्वर O Lord Rama, ततः then onwards, हरिः monkeys, शापभयात् for fear of the curse, भीतः frightened, महागिरिम् great mountain, ऋष्यमूकम् Rishyamuka, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, द्रष्टुं वापि even to see, नेच्छति does not like.

40009405.author: Translation
40009405.content: 'O Lord Rama because of the fear of the curse, Vali will not enter the great Rishyamuka mountain nor will he like to see it.

40009406.author: पदार्थः
40009406.content: राम O Rama, अहम् I, तस्य his, अप्रवेशम् entry prohibited, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, विषादेन apprehension, विवर्जितः without, सहामात्यः accompanied by ministers, इदम् this, महावनम् great forest, विचरामि I am roaming about.

40009406.author: Translation
40009406.content: 'O Rama aware of the prohibition of Vali from entering the place, I roam about this great forest  accompanied by my ministers without any apprehension.

40009407.author: पदार्थः
40009407.content: वीर्योत्सेकात् with pride of prowess, निरस्तस्य thrown away, तस्य दुन्दुभेः Dundubhi's, गिरिकूटोपमो as the mountain peak, महान् huge, एषः this, अस्थिनिचयः heap of bones, सम्प्रकाशते is shining

40009407.author: Translation
40009407.content: 'Hurled with the pride of his(Vali's) prowess is this heap of bones of Dundubhi here, which shines like a huge mountain peak.

40009408.author: पदार्थः
40009408.content: शाखावलम्बिनः  branches overlapping one another, इमे these, सप्त seven, विपुलाः sturdy, सालाः Sala trees, यत्र there, एकम् one, वाली Vali, ओजसा his own, निष्पत्रयितुम् to remove its leaves, घटते he is competent.

40009408.author: Translation
40009408.content: 'Look at these seven sturdy Sala trees with branches  of one overlapping the other.  Vali was able to remove all the leaves of one Sala tree with just one arrow.

40009409.author: पदार्थः
40009409.content: राम O Rama, अस्य his, असमम् unequalled, एतत् this, वीर्यम् strength, प्रकीर्तितम् is narrated, नृप king, समरे in a combat, तं वालिनम् that Vali's, हन्तुम् to kill, कथम् how is it, शक्ष्यसे it is possible for you?

40009409.author: Translation
40009409.content: 'O Rama Vali's strength and fame related by me is unequalled. O king how is it possible for you to kill him in a combat?'

40009410.author: पदार्थः
40009410.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तथा that way, ब्रुवाणम् while he spoke, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, प्रहसन् with a smile, अब्रवीत् said, कस्मिन् in which, कर्मणि in action, निवृत्ते when carried out, वालिनः Vali's, वधम् killing, श्रद्दध्याः trust

40009410.author: Translation
40009410.content: Smiling, Lakshmana asked Sugriva, 'By what action will you trust?. By the fulfilment of which task (by Rama) will you have faith?'

40009411.author: पदार्थः
40009411.content: अथ then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तम् him, उवाच said, पुरा earlier, सः वाली that Vali, इमान् these, सप्तसालान् seven sala trees, एवम् in this way, एकैकशः one after the other, अथ then, असकृत् several times, विव्याध struck.

40009411.author: Translation
40009411.content: Then Sugriva told Lakshmana that earlier Vali had split through these seven Sala trees one after the other, several times.

40009412.author: पदार्थः
40009412.content: रामः Rama, अपि also, एषाम् these, द्रुमम् trees, एकेन with one, बाणेन with arrow, दारयेत् pierce through(split), रामस्य Rama's, विक्रमम् prowess, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, वालिनम् Vali, निहतम् killing, मन्ये I think, अपि also.

40009412.author: Translation
40009412.content: 'If I see Rama splitting these trees with one arrow, I will believe he can kill Vali with his prowess.

40009413.author: पदार्थः
40009413.content: लक्ष्मण  Lakshmana, हतस्य of the dead, महिषस्य buffalo's, अस्थि skeleton, एकेन by one, पादेन by the foot, उद्यम्य lifted, तरसा with his strength, द्वेधनुः शते a distance of eight hundred hands (distance of two hundred bows), प्रक्षिपेच्चापि if he can also hurl.

40009413.author: Translation
40009413.content: 'O Lakshmana and if Rama can also lift the dead buffalo's (Dundubhi's) skeleton and hurl it to a distance  of two hundred bows with one of his feet.

40009414.author: पदार्थः
40009414.content: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रक्तान्तलोचनम् with reddened eyes, रामम् Rama, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, मुहूर्तम् for a moment after, ध्यात्वा thinking, काकुत्स्थम् Rama, पुनरेव again, वचः these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40009414.author: Translation
40009414.content: Having said this and thinking for a moment, Sugriva again said to the heroic Rama whose eyes had turned red.

40009415.author: पदार्थः
40009415.content: शूरश्च hero, शूरघाती च killer of heroes, प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः wellknown for prowess and valour, बलवान् powerful, वानरः वाली monkey Vali, संयुगेषु in combat, अपराजितः unconquered.

40009415.author: Translation
40009415.content: 'Powerful Vali is valiant and has killed brave fighters. He is wellknown for his prowess and valour. He has not faced defeat in war.

40009416.author: पदार्थः
40009416.content: सुरैरपि even by gods, दुष्कराणि difficult, तस्य his, कर्माणि tasks, दृश्यन्ते are seen(all over), यानि all those, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking of, भीतः fear, अहम् I, ऋष्यमूकम् at Rishyamuka, उपाश्रितः I have taken refuge.

40009416.author: Translation
40009416.content: 'Even gods cannot do what he has done. Thinking of all this and being afraid of him, I have taken refuge at Rishyamuka.

40009417.author: पदार्थः
40009417.content: तम् him, वानरेन्द्रम् lord of monkeys, अजय्यम् invincible, अधृष्यम् one who can not be overpowered, अमर्षणम् indignant, विचिन्तयन् while thinking over, अहम् I, ऋष्यमूकम् Rishyamuka, न मुञ्चामि I have not left, इयम this.

40009417.author: Translation
40009417.content: 'Thinking that this indignant, invincible lord of the monkeys, cannot be overpowered, I have not stepped out of Rishyamuka.

40009418.author: पदार्थः
40009418.content: (अहम् I), उद्विग्नः agitated, शङ्कितः frightened, अनुरक्तैः who are devoted to me, वरैः excellent, हनुमत्प्रमुखैः by Hanuman and others, अमात्यैः with ministers, सह along with, महावने in this great forest, विचरामि I am roaming.

40009418.author: Translation
40009418.content: Agitated and fearful, I roam this great forest together with my devoted, excellent ministers headed by Hanuman.

40009419.author: पदार्थः
40009419.content: श्लाघ्यम् praiseworthy, सन्मित्रम् a good friend, मे to me, उपलब्धम् Is obtained, मित्रवत्सल O loyal to friends, पुरुषव्याघ्र tiger among men, अहम् I am, हिमवन्तमिव like the Himalaya, त्वाम् you, आश्रितः seek your protection.

40009419.author: Translation
40009419.content: 'I have discovered in you a faithful friend. O tiger among men, O venerable one, you are to me like the Himalayas.

40009420.author: पदार्थः
40009420.content: किं तु but, अहम् I, बलशालिनः  mighty, दुर्भ्रातुः bad brother's, तस्य his, बलज्ञः know his strength, राघव Rama, समरे in war, तव your, वीर्यं तु power also, मे I, अप्रत्यक्षम् not see.

40009420.author: Translation
40009420.content: 'What to do? I know the strength of my mighty bad brother. But so far I have not seen your power in a battle.

40009421.author: पदार्थः
40009421.content: अहम् I am, त्वाम् your, न खलु तुलये indeed do not compare, नावमन्ये I do not insult you, न भीषये  not to scare , तस्य his, भीमैः by dreadful, कर्मभिः by his actions, मम  in me, कातर्यम् cowardice, जनितम् is created.

40009421.author: Translation
40009421.content: 'The dreadful acts of Vali have made me feel timid. This is not to compare you with him or your strength with his or insult you and scare you.

40009422.author: पदार्थः
40009422.content: राघव Rama, ते you, वाणी word, प्रमाणम् evidence, धैर्यम् courage, आकृतिः appearance, भस्मच्छन्नम् covered with ashes, आनलम् इव like fire, परम् supreme, तेजः strength, सूचयन्ति indicate, कामम् no doubt.

40009422.author: Translation
40009422.content: 'Rama  your word and your courage indicate your supreme strength which is like fire covered with ashes.'

40009423.author: पदार्थः
40009423.content: रामः Rama, महात्मनः great soul, तस्य सुग्रीवस्य that Sugriva's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अथ then, हरिं प्रति seeing Sugriva, स्मितपूर्वम् smiling gently, प्रत्युवाच  replied.

40009423.author: Translation
40009423.content: Having heard the great Sugriva, Rama replied with a gentle smile:

40009424.author: पदार्थः
40009424.content: वानर monkey, विक्रमे in valour, अस्मासु in us, तव to you, प्रत्ययः faith, न यदि if not, अहम् I, समरे in combat, श्लाघ्यम् praiseworthy, प्रत्ययम् confidence, ते to you, उत्पादयामि create.

40009424.author: Translation
40009424.content: 'If you have no confidence in my strength in fight, O monkey, I will create it in you so much so that you will admire it.'

40009425.author: पदार्थः
40009425.content: लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, महाबाहुः longarmed one, वीर्यवान् mighty, राघवः Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, सान्त्वं In a pleasing way, दुन्दुभेः Dundubhi's, कायम् body, लीलया easily, पादाङ्गुष्ठेन with the toe, तोलयित्वा lifting, असुरस्य demon's, शुष्काम् dried, तनुम् body, दशयोजनम् ten yojanas, चिक्षेप flung

40009425.author: Translation
40009425.content: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

40009426.author: पदार्थः
40009426.content: लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, महाबाहुः longarmed one, वीर्यवान् mighty, राघवः Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, सान्त्वं In a pleasing way, दुन्दुभेः Dundubhi's, कायम् body, लीलया easily, पादाङ्गुष्ठेन with the toe, तोलयित्वा lifting, असुरस्य demon's, शुष्काम् dried, तनुम् body, दशयोजनम् ten yojanas, चिक्षेप flung

40009426.author: Translation
40009426.content: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

40009427.author: पदार्थः
40009427.content: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, क्षिप्तम् the thrown, कायम् body, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, ततः then, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, अर्थवत्  meaningful, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अग्रतः In the presence.

40009427.author: Translation
40009427.content: Having seen Rama flinging the body, Sugriva said to him again in the presence of Lakshmanameaningfully:

40009428.author: पदार्थः
40009428.content: सखे friend, तदा that time, परिश्रान्तेन by the tired, मत्तेन by the intoxicated, मे भ्रात्रा  by my brother, वालिना by Vali, पुरा earlier, आर्द्रः wet, समांसः with flesh, प्रत्यग्रः fresh, कायः body, क्षिप्तः flung, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu race, राघव Raghava, सम्प्रति now, लघुः light, निर्मांसः without flesh, तृणभूतश्च like a bunch of grass, प्रहर्षेण playfully, भवता by you, एवम् this, क्षिप्तम् flung.

40009428.author: Translation
40009428.content: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.

40009429.author: पदार्थः
40009429.content: सखे friend, तदा that time, परिश्रान्तेन by the tired, मत्तेन by the intoxicated, मे भ्रात्रा  by my brother, वालिना by Vali, पुरा earlier, आर्द्रः wet, समांसः with flesh, प्रत्यग्रः fresh, कायः body, क्षिप्तः flung, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu race, राघव Raghava, सम्प्रति now, लघुः light, निर्मांसः without flesh, तृणभूतश्च like a bunch of grass, प्रहर्षेण playfully, भवता by you, एवम् this, क्षिप्तम् flung.

40009429.author: Translation
40009429.content: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.

40009430.author: पदार्थः
40009430.content: अत्र here (in this case), तव your, बलम् strength, अधिकं वा is more  or, तस्य वा or his, ज्ञातुम् to know, न शक्यम् not able, राघव Rama, आर्द्रम् wet, शुष्कमिति dried, एतत् this, सुमहत् great, अन्तरं हि difference.

40009430.author: Translation
40009430.content: 'I was unable to gauge whether your strength is more  than his (Vali's) since there is a great difference between a dry body and a wet one.

40009431.author: पदार्थः
40009431.content: तात O dear, तव your, तस्य च and his, यत् such, बले strength, स एव that alone, संशयः  doubt, एकम् one, सालम् Sala tree, निर्भिद्य after splitling through, व्यक्तिः demonstrated, भवेत् will be known, बलाबले strength or otherwise.

40009431.author: Translation
40009431.content: 'O Dear, therefore, I have my doubt about your relative strength. If you can split a sala tree with a single arrow then can your strength or weakness be demonstrated.

40009432.author: पदार्थः
40009432.content: आततम् stretched, हस्तिहस्तमिव like the elephant's trunk, एतत् that, कार्मुकम् bow, सज्यम् strung(tie it with string), कृत्वा after doing, आकर्णपूर्णम् drawing it (the string) to the ear, आयम्य after stretching, महाशरम् great arrow, विसृजस्व release.

40009432.author: Translation
40009432.content: 'Now string your bow, draw it like the trunk of an elephant up to your ear and release the great arrow.

40009433.author: पदार्थः
40009433.content: राजन् king, त्वया your, प्रहितः good, शरः arrow, इमं सालम् this sala tree, विदारयिष्यति will pierce through, अत्र then, संशयः doubt, नास्ति will not be there, विमर्शेन clear, अलम् enough, ध्रुवम् certainly, मम to me, प्रियम् gladden, कुरुष्व do, मया my, प्रतिशापितः not to test you.

40009433.author: Translation
40009433.content: 'It will be enough and my doubt will be cleared. If you can pierce the sala tree with your arrow it will be my pleasure and not a test of your strength.

40009434.author: पदार्थः
40009434.content: तेजस्सु among the brilliant, रविः Sun, यथा as, वरः best, महाद्रिषु among the great mountains, हिमवान् शैलः Himalaya mountain, यथा as, चतुष्पात्सु among the quadrupeds, केसरी lion, यथा as, वरः best, तथा similarly, नराणाम् among men, विक्रमे in valour, वरः best, असि you are.

40009434.author: Translation
40009434.content: 'Just as the Sun is the best among the brilliant, the Himalayas among the great mountains, the lion among the quadrupeds, so also you are the best among men of valour.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends  the eleventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
